findings: PUBLICATION_CAN_BE_A_SCHOOL: recurring Scuola del Libro collaboration makes the publication a capability-generating environment, not only an output.
CONTENT_MEDIUM_MAY_REWRITE_GRID: photography, specimens and inserted objects are allowed to change spatial organization rather than being normalized into one page recipe.
ARTIFACTS_KEEP_LOCAL_MATERIAL_GRAMMAR: glued student projects, stationery, invoices and folded inserts retain object identity inside the issue.
COHERENCE_WITHOUT_FLATTENING: editorial authority can coordinate heterogeneous contributors and artifacts without making them visually identical.
MORE_SPACE_RECOMPOSES_RHYTHM_NOT_TEMPLATE: the 88-page 5-6 issue expands sequence and evidence instead of merely stretching an ordinary issue.
THEORY_REQUIRES_EXECUTED_EVIDENCE: editorial claims repeatedly sit beside specimens, student work, photography and production examples.
relation_to_1936: 1936 showed that subject scale may rewrite cadence, page count, binding and sequence. 1937 adds that content medium and contributor ecology may rewrite layout grammar and make the publication itself a learning system.
rejections: Do not learn a fixed period-looking grid.
Do not copy mastheads, logos or historical motifs.
Do not turn inserts into a decorative collage recipe.
Do not equate technical novelty with editorial quality.
Do not force Italian editorial grammar onto non-applicable tasks.
next: Continue to 1938 evidence. No Capability Registry/System Atlas promotion until blind-transfer acceptance passes.
